analysis: prediction-level verdict sensitivity (NOT ranking / leaderboard impact)
primary_informative_subset: rows with empty_prediction == False AND a binary (0/1) verdict from all seven primary scorers
justification: empty predictions (117/158) are dominated by an output-floor effect and mostly fail every scorer trivially;
rows with a scorer exception (CySpider TypeError on list/map values) have no complete seven-scorer verdict vector, so non-unanimity is undefined for them;
the rule uses only columns frozen in the main audit run and was written before any study S20 metric was computed.
context_sets_reported_separately: all rows with seven binary verdicts (154)
metrics: max - min per-scorer acceptance rate on the same subset (with and without CypherLens)
strict-majority (>= 4 of 7) verdict vs each scorer
status: DEFINED BEFORE ANY STUDY S20 S2 METRIC
